summary: Of Aiello Calabro in Calabria (1714–1782), husband of Cecilia Vecchio; an ancestor in the unsupported Guercio pedigree.
bio: Nicola Guercio Nuzio was born at Aiello Calabro in Calabria on 18 August 1714 and died there on 5 March 1782. Family records pair him with Cecilia Vecchio, born in 1718, and attach a coat of arms to the family, but his place in the Guercio pedigree is unsupported by records. He is not to be confused with the Nicola Guercio of San Mango, born about 1741 to 1750, who married Maria Colosimo.

researchLog.note: Imported from the project handoff (research rounds 1–3, Oct 2026).

Round 4 searched without result: Antenati (antenati.cultura.gov.it): blocked for this run (per brief); not retried; FamilySearch record search / Italian civil images: blocked (401/403 per brief); San Mango d'Aquino parish indexes 1653-1942 (baptisms, marriages, deaths): no entry (family was at Aiello Calabro/Cannovali, Cosenza, before c.1810); ItalianParishRecords.org: no Aiello Calabro page with indexes

Round 4: nothing new. Round 4 found that Carmine G. Fiorillo's mother was Maria Marrello (1840 marriage), and her 1846 burial names her mother as Giacinta Gabriele Fiorillo, not Ippolita Guercio. This Aiello pedigree (Morrello Magaro / Guercio Nuzio / Fata) is therefore doubly unverified: neither the dates nor the attachment to John's line are supported by anything seen.
